description: This file contains shell functions primarily related to project maintenance, artifact validation, branch and worktree management, and logging/log analysis. It defines utility functions used for scripting tasks such as verifying artifacts, managing git worktrees, and parsing logs.

methods.name: require_artifact
methods.description: Checks if the specified file exists and is non-empty; exits if not.

methods.name: path_is_docsish
methods.description: Determines if a path points to a documentation-related file or directory.

methods.name: path_is_testish
methods.description: Determines if a path appears to be a test file or directory.

methods.name: path_is_maintainer_workflow_only
methods.description: Checks if a path is part of maintainer-only workflows.

methods.name: file_list_is_docsish_only
methods.description: Checks if a list of files contains only documentation files.

methods.name: changelog_required_for_changed_files
methods.description: Decides if a changelog is needed based on changed files.

methods.name: print_review_stdout_summary
methods.description: Outputs a review summary based on review.md and review.json artifacts.

methods.name: print_relevant_log_excerpt
methods.description: Prints relevant error lines or last lines of a log file for debugging.

methods.name: print_unrelated_gate_failure_guidance
methods.description: Provides guidance on handling unrelated gate failures based on label.

methods.name: run_quiet_logged
methods.description: Runs a command, logs output, and handles success/failure reporting.

methods.name: bootstrap_deps_if_needed
methods.description: Installs dependencies if required (e.g., pnpm).

methods.name: wait_for_pr_head_sha
methods.description: Waits for a PR's head SHA to match expected, polling with delays.

methods.name: is_author_email_merge_error
methods.description: Checks if a message indicates an author email merge error.

methods.name: merge_author_email_candidates
methods.description: Provides a list of candidate emails for merge author attribution.

methods.name: common_repo_root
methods.description: Determines the root directory of the repository.

methods.name: worktree_path_for_branch
methods.description: Finds the worktree path associated with a specific branch.

methods.name: worktree_is_registered
methods.description: Checks if a given directory is a registered git worktree.

methods.name: resolve_existing_dir_path
methods.description: Resolves and outputs the absolute path of an existing directory.

methods.name: is_repo_pr_worktree_dir
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a PR-specific git worktree.

methods.name: remove_worktree_if_present
methods.description: Removes a worktree if it exists, with various cleanup checks.

methods.name: delete_local_branch_if_safe
methods.description: Deletes a local branch safely if it is not checked out in a worktree.
